name: python-sync-skips-async-guidance
description: Regression: async terms in strings and a separate coroutine file do not activate async guidance for a synchronous target. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root outside any SKILL.md-rooted directory, with the Python implementation profile available in the plugin under test.
prompt: In labels.py, make normalize_label strip surrounding whitespace and casefold the result. Preserve HELP_TEXT exactly and keep the function synchronous. No other file needs changing.
trap: A substring search for async terms or a scan of unrelated Python files incorrectly loads async.md despite no qualifying code construct or import in the target file or planned edit.

assertions.text: Agent activates python for labels.py and reads implement/index.md plus all three always-load guidance files before editing.
Agent does not load python/implement/async.md: HELP_TEXT contains only literal text, and background.py is outside the task's target files.
Agent implements strip followed by casefold without introducing async constructs, runtime imports, or new dependencies.
